purpose: ANZSCO occupation master list - canonical occupation dimension
notes: PK stays ANZSCO code (not migrating to OSCA). 5 rows are ANZSCO-2013-only (e.g. 394111 Cabinetmaker).

purpose: SkillSelect EOI invitation rounds - threshold points + invitations per visa/occupation/round
notes: Unique key is on occupation_name_raw, not occupation_code (NULLs are distinct in Postgres). 0 unresolved as of 2026-08-18.

purpose: Annual occupation ceiling utilization
notes: Per-occupation ceilings not published anywhere at 6-digit grain. Two fabricated rows were removed 2026-08-18; seed file is now comment-only.

purpose: Derived trend direction, computed from eoi_rounds threshold history
notes: Only table with no source_url - always reliability_tier='derived'.

purpose: Crawl registry - content hash, freshness, extraction watermark
notes: last_extracted_at only advances after successful parse+persist - the anti-freeze watermark.

purpose: Static reference facts per visa subclass
notes: Built columns: code, name, visa_category + provenance trio. NOT built: family, permanence, age_limit, work_rights_description, family_inclusion_rule, residency_requirement_description, occupation_list_required, onward_pathway_code, base_application_cost, points_test_required. permanence has NO SOURCE anywhere found.

purpose: English test score bands and migration points
notes: Re-sourced from legislation (source 7's HA page is prose-only).

purpose: Skills assessing authorities
notes: turnaround_estimate/cost have NO SOURCE - ~38 separate sites, ship NULL.

purpose: Many-to-many join: occupation <-> assessing body
notes: Table 5 keys by abbreviation, assessing_bodies by full name - needs an explicit mapping. Some occupations specify 'either body' (disjunction, not expressible as plain rows).

purpose: GSM points test - what earns how many points
notes: Single table covers 189/190/491 - not per-subclass.

purpose: Editorial log of budget/legislative/program changes
notes: Primary URL is a soft-404; stays editorial by design.

purpose: Per-state, per-occupation nomination program status
notes: Most columns (fee, points, job-offer, decision time, documents) have NO SOURCE on any state page. Deliberately built last (highest curation effort).

purpose: Occupations added/removed from MLTSSL/STSOL/ROL/state lists
notes: Register serves compilations, not diffs - needs OData API (source 23) or diffing C20 across compilation_dates.

purpose: Visa processing time estimates
notes: API returns a percentile distribution, not a median - median_days needs re-modelling. Current unique key has no stream column - 76 combos will collide on load without adding one.

purpose: Annual migration program planning levels by stream
notes: Buildable today - the planning-levels page has no PDFs, full 3-year table is in hidden-field JSON.

purpose: Application volumes per funnel stage (submitted/invited/granted)
notes: Built: (visa_code, program_year) + granted_count + one provenance trio, 1,710,097 total grants. NOT built: submitted_count (NO SOURCE, permanent NULL), invited_count (pending grain reconciliation with eoi_rounds), the second provenance trio, as_of_date. No non-negative check on granted_count - BP0068 is confidentialised (one real row is -2).

purpose: Prose reference for health/character/English requirements
notes: 3 rows, near-static, buildable today from decoded prose.

purpose: JSA occupation shortage/future-demand ratings
notes: shortage_rating vocabulary confirmed (S/M/R/NS). future_demand_rating has NO SOURCE - JSA's field is null throughout.

purpose: Carries ANZSCO<->OSCA relationship without migrating occupations' PK
notes: Not one-to-one - ABS marks partial matches with a 'p' flag.

purpose: Current membership of MLTSSL/STSOL/ROL/CSOL (point-in-time, not a diff)
notes: Added because list_change_log alone has no way to store present-day membership. list_change_log becomes derivative of this (diff two compilation_dates).

purpose: Per-subclass, per-stream visa fees
notes: Promoted off visa_subclasses - 150 fee records can't live as one scalar column on a 6-row table.

purpose: Name->code crosswalk (LIN-first resolution) that unblocks eoi_rounds
notes: Deliberately has NO FK to occupations.code - it's a reference mapping that legitimately names codes occupations doesn't carry (an FK would abort loading on those rows). Added by the 2026-08-17 audit, not in the original A/B/C plan.

purpose: Registry of every external data source koshi acquires from
notes: Build when source count is well past today's 6.

How a resource gets extracted - parser/provider/strategy, priority order
notes: json_root_key and table_index config keys are load-bearing per the audit (Home Affairs pages vary root key; LIN tables are positional).

purpose: Canonical Pydantic schema for a domain record

Cadence and freshness SLA per source
notes: Build when scheduling stops being manual (python -m koshi run by hand).

notes: Build when replay-without-refetch or snapshot diffing is actually needed.

purpose: manifest.json metadata from each acquisition, queryable
Unified lineage table across all ETL stages
Records rejected by quality gates, for human review + replay
